CustomField.description: Marks this event as a resume checkpoint. When true, the trigger handler calls EventBus.TriggerContext.currentContext().setResumeCheckpoint() after successfully processing this event, so a later failure in the same batch retries only the events after it instead of the whole batch.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Check to mark this row as a checkpoint - a retry triggered by a later failure in the same batch will skip everything up to and including this event.
CustomField.label: Set Checkpoint
